tema: Microorganisms: helpful and harmful germs, hand washing
objetivo: That the student understands that microorganisms are tiny living things, that some help us (food, soil) and others make us sick, and that washing hands and basic hygiene prevent illness.
hatsumon: Are all germs bad for us?
